description: Export the canvas (or given ids) as PNG or JPG. With path, writes the file (absolute path, matching extension, refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true); without path, returns the image.

beautify.description: Frame the image on a background. true uses the user’s beautify settings, an object overrides some of them, false turns it off. Omit to follow the user’s setting.

ids.description: Export only these elements. Defaults to the whole canvas (or crop).

path.description: Absolute file path to write. Omit to receive the image in the response.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_export
title: Export image
